display_name.description: The display name of the Security Health Analytics custom module. This display name becomes the finding category for all findings returned by the module.
display_name.rationale: The display name improves readability and categorization but does not directly affect security.

enablement_state.description: The enablement state of the custom module. Possible values are: ENABLED, DISABLED.
enablement_state.rationale: If the module is disabled, findings will not be generated, resulting in blind spots in threat detection.

custom_config.description: The user-specified configuration for the custom module, defining conditions, outputs, and selectors.
custom_config.rationale: The custom configuration dictates what misconfigurations are detected. Weak or empty configs reduce coverage.

predicate.description: CEL expression to evaluate resources and generate findings when true.
predicate.rationale: The predicate determines detection logic. Without it, the module will not detect violations.

custom_output.description: Custom output properties to add additional context to findings.
custom_output.rationale: Custom output enhances visibility but does not directly affect security posture.

resource_selector.description: The resource types that the custom module evaluates.
resource_selector.rationale: Ensures findings are scoped to the correct resource types. Misconfigured selectors may miss critical resources.

severity.description: The severity assigned to findings from this module. Valid values: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW.
severity.rationale: Severity impacts prioritization of findings in incident response workflows.

description.description: Text describing the vulnerability or misconfiguration detected by the custom module.
description.rationale: The description helps analysts understand the issue but does not affect detection logic.

recommendation.description: Steps recommended for resolving the detected misconfiguration or vulnerability.
recommendation.rationale: Recommendations are critical for guiding remediation after detection.

folder.description: Numerical ID of the parent folder where the custom module is deployed.
folder.rationale: Specifies scope of the module but does not directly influence detection logic.
